_comment: Christmas planner data. Every figure carries a source. Side dishes without an official source take the cook's own pack or recipe time instead of a number from us.

fss.name: Food Standards Scotland, Christmas food safety checklist

thaw.text: Thaw a frozen turkey in the fridge, on the bottom shelf, allowing 10 to 12 hours per kg. Don't thaw it at room temperature.

safety.text: Don't wash the raw turkey. It splashes bacteria around the sink and worktops.
Get leftovers into the fridge within two hours of cooking, and eat them within two days or freeze them.
Reheat leftovers only once, until they're steaming hot.

potatoes.label: Roast potatoes
potatoes.text: Parboil for 5 to 10 minutes, drain and shake to rough up the edges, then roast at 200°C (gas mark 6) for 40 to 50 minutes.
